_why: The filing goldens' matrix (test_filing_goldens.py): every lane that files into a firm's Smokeball by every ending, captured from origin/main c65294ee9 before wave 3 folds the four filing procedures into one module. A cell is recorded in <lane>/<ending>.json or named under not_applicable with its reason; a missing cell fails. frozen names the send records (frozen-<record>.json, recaptured only by JOBS_WRITE_FILING_FROZEN=1, never by the integrity job) that resume/<state>.json loads, each with what the vendor holds: none may send again.

not_applicable.update/folder_taken: the update files into the delivered chronology's own folder, by its id; no folder is chosen or created by name
not_applicable.update_review/folder_taken: the review files into the delivered chronology's own folder, by its id; no folder is chosen or created by name
not_applicable.revise/folder_taken: revise writes new versions of files already filed, by id; it creates no folder
not_applicable.revise/name_taken: revise writes new versions of files already filed, by id; it never names a new file
not_applicable.revise/send_raises_placeholder: a new version lands whole on its one PUT or not at all; there is no POST to leave a placeholder row
not_applicable.library/folder_taken: the library folder is the firm's standing Document Library, found by name and never created
not_applicable.library/shape_upper_ext: the library names its file from the firm's config ('Template - <Kind>.docx'); no other name shape is ever filed
not_applicable.library/shape_no_ext: the library names its file from the firm's config ('Template - <Kind>.docx'); no other name shape is ever filed
not_applicable.revise/rebuilt_after_send: revise files new versions by id under compare-and-stop; it keeps no per-name send record to rebuild against
not_applicable.library/rebuilt_after_send: the library filing keeps no send record across attempts: each attempt reads the library afresh
not_applicable.chronology/resume_name_taken_after_place: only a filing into a folder this run did not create numbers a taken name, so only the update and its review resume one
